description.value: Fleetwood Community Centre is a City of Surrey municipal recreation facility located in the heart of the Fleetwood neighbourhood, adjacent to Fleetwood Park, Francis Park, and the Fleetwood branch of Surrey Libraries. It offers drop-in and registered programs for all ages including gymnasium sports, fitness classes, and seniors activities. Touring cyclists passing through Surrey's eastern suburbs would find it a convenient public stop given its central neighbourhood location and broad community programming.

The facility appears active and publicly accessible.
